product_metadata.title: Step2 583199 Express Package Delivery Box, 31"H x 18"W x 23"D, Black
features: SECURE PACKAGES: Keep packages safe and out of sight from porch pirates, worry-free outdoor storage
SMART STORAGE: “Deliveries" clearly marked on all sides to alert carriers, easy-open lid allows for quick package retrieval
WEATHER PROOF: Designed to endure the outdoor elements, ensuring your packages remain dry and secure in any weather
LARGE INTERIOR: Ample space, fits most parcel sizes, interior 31"H x 18" W x 23"D
DURABLE: High-quality plastic, designed to blend in and protect your packages
description: The Step2 Express Package Delivery Box is the ideal solution for safe and easy package delivery. With its sturdy and secure construction, this delivery box provides you with piece of mind by keeping your things safe until you're ready to collect them. The easy-open lid makes it simple to retrieve your products. No more fumbling with difficult locks or lids; our delivery box offers quick and easy package recovery. The Step2 Express Package Delivery Box is designed to withstand the worst weather conditions, keeping your packages dry and secure in any environment. Say goodbye to concerns about your important delivery being damaged by rain, snow, or excessive heat.

This delivery box's spacious inside accommodates packages of all sizes. With dimensions of 31"H x 18" W x 23"D, it can easily accommodate larger packages, ensuring that everything you receive fits comfortably inside. Made of high-quality materials, our delivery box boasts a durable construction that is built to last, not only protecting your packages from external elements but also ensuring long-lasting performance, providing you with a reliable storage solution for years to come. Say goodbye to the stress of missing or damaged packages. Trust in the Step2 Express Package Delivery Box, where secure delivery storage and easy package retrieval combine to give an outstanding customer experience.
